title: Woman charged with stabbing man multiple times in Syracuse
summary: A 38-year-old man was stabbed multiple times by a woman in Syracuse early Wednesday morning (August 5, 2026) on Lakeview Avenue and hospitalized. Syracuse Police Department responded to the incident at 2:35 a.m. and the woman was charged in connection with the stabbing.
